name: 1 Submit task
description:
Add seed nodes that contain the text in the "text" key. To add such nodes, you can prepare a CSV file (semicolon as separator) and load it from the Add Nodes menu option.

Revise the rules in the payload. Make sure it is valid JSON. Be aware that JSON does not support line breaks in literal values (between quotes). Instead of providing the rules directly in the payload, you can prepare a rules.json file (array of rules as in the payload), put it into the upload folder (see the setting below the payload) and then use the placeholder  "rules": <"rules.json"|file:txt>

Then login to the Databoard Service with your credentials and fetch data.

If the result is ready within 10 seconds (see the wait parameter), it will be returned directly. If it takes longer, use the preset to get task results with the task ID. For larger samples we recommend to set the wait parameter to 0, submit all tasks, then fetch them in a different step.

You can repeat the identical request later, the result will be returned from the Databoard cache once it has been successfully retrieved.

See https://databoard.uni-muenster.de for the documentation.
